help.title: How can we help?
help.intro: Short answers about how BAQUEANO works: what is real, what is missing and where to do each thing.
help.g1_d: Search by name or by territory on the map.
help.g2_d: Tell My adventure about your trip in your own words.
help.g3_d: Messages go straight to the business, with no middlemen.
help.a1: No. BAQUEANO helps you discover places and contact them directly. Prices, availability, payments and cancellations are agreed with each business or guide.
help.q2: Are prices and opening hours exact?
help.a2: Every fact shows its source and the date it was checked, but conditions change. Confirm with the business before you travel.
help.q3: Where do the photos come from?
help.a3: They are real photos of Nicaragua with free licenses, from Wikimedia Commons. Each one credits its author and license on the credits page.
help.a4: Not to browse. An account lets you save favorites and itineraries, write to businesses and publish stories.
help.q5: How do I report a problem?
help.a5: On the reports page. If there is immediate danger, first call 118 (Police), 115 (Fire) or 128 (Red Cross).
help.q6: What do you store in my browser?
help.a6: Only what the site needs to work. Anonymous browsing measurement only starts if you accept it, and you can change your choice on the cookies page.
help.q7: Does it cost anything to list my business?
help.a7: We charge no commissions and nothing to appear. Business plans are not defined yet, and the plans page says so.
help.a8: Once the team checks that the details are accurate. Meanwhile you can see its status in your profile.
help.a9: 10 languages. If a native speaker has not reviewed a translation yet, the page says so.
help.more_text: Write to us through the channels on the contact page.
